# VitaBoost zcache (vendored)

`vb_zcache.c` / `vb_zcache.h` from [VitaBoost](https://github.com/Swisha33/VitaBoost) (MIT, `LICENSE.vitaboost`),
commit f1c2b44, with `lz4.c` / `lz4.h` from [LZ4](https://github.com/lz4/lz4) (BSD-2-Clause, `LICENSE.lz4`).
Used by the texture read-back cache in `src/lib/winapi/d3d9_resources.cpp` (setting `texture_zcache_mb`).
Update by copying the files from VitaBoost; do not edit them here.
